title: Business Summary
description: Reusable business, brand, or seller identity summary shared across discovery profiles, multi-seller catalogs, and transactional sessions.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the business, brand, or seller (e.g., "Joe's Pizza").

legal_name.description: Registered legal name of the business or seller, when different from the display `name` (e.g., "Joe's Pizza LLC").

description.description: Human-readable description or 'about' summary of the business or seller in one or more formats (`plain`, `markdown`, `html`).

media.description: Brand or seller media assets, such as a primary logo (`role: 'logo'`), compact square icon (`role: 'icon'`), or cover image (`role: 'cover'`).

links.description: Canonical customer-facing `website` storefront URL and business-wide policy links (`privacy_policy`, `terms_of_service`, `refund_policy`, `shipping_policy`, `faq`).

address.description: Publicly disclosable corporate, headquarters, or statutory establishment address of the business or seller. Physical retail branches live in `dev.ucp.common.location.*`.
